why: rc20: map label outline, item names and kill targets marked

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc20 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

New: the Persian hover label of the world map has a black outline (readable on the parchment).
New: 2400 item names in the quest texts are marked, so they take the item colour. Items follow the item switch: while it is locked they show their English name, like in your bags.
Fix: a kill target that the quest text names differently from its own marker ('Forest Lurker') is coloured too.
Includes rc7 to rc19.

Data from ForeverDB.net
